entities.summary: Giovanni Michelucci was an Italian architect, urban planner, and designer. He had the good fortune to live a long life almost entirely within the span of the twentieth century, giving us a valuable witness through his work with innovative architectural vernaculars and proposals, from his understanding of the complexity of events, transformations, and ideas that animated the twentieth century. He was one of the major Italian architects of that century, known for famous projects such as the Firenze Santa Maria Novella railway station and the San Giovanni Battista church on the Autostrada del Sole.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Giovanni Michelucci's work on Italian architecture and urban planning had a significant regional impact, contributing to the modernization of Florence and Italy during the mid-20th century. His designs, such as the Firenze Santa Maria Novella railway station, reflect his understanding of functionalism and rationality in architecture.
